description: This PHP source file defines the 'BuzzShare' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing social media shares or posts related to the Buzz feature. It includes properties such as post reference, employee author, like/comment counts, type, text content, and timestamps, along with related getters and setters.

classes.name: BuzzShare
classes.description: Entity class representing social media shares or posts within the OrangeHRM Buzz module, including properties for post details, employee, engagement metrics, content, and timestamps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: getPost
methods.description: Returns the BuzzPost associated with this share.

methods.name: setPost
methods.description: Associates a BuzzPost object with this share.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who created the share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this share.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of share (post or share).

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the share.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the share.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last update timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the updated timestamp to current UTC time.
